name: page_fill
expr: [(n, s.FillStyle.value, s.FillColor, s.FillTransparence) for n in ('Standard','First Page','P_solid','P_solid_transp','P_gradient','P_gradient_transp','P_gradient_tgrad','P_hatch','P_hatch_nobg','P_bitmap_tile','P_bitmap_stretch','P_bitmap_once','P_none','P_shared','P_shared2') for s in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('PageStyles').getByName(n)]]

name: page_gradient
expr: [(n, g.Style.value, g.StartColor, g.EndColor, g.Angle, g.Border) for n in ('Standard','First Page','P_solid','P_solid_transp','P_gradient','P_gradient_transp','P_gradient_tgrad','P_hatch','P_hatch_nobg','P_bitmap_tile','P_bitmap_stretch','P_bitmap_once','P_none','P_shared','P_shared2') for s in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('PageStyles').getByName(n)] if s.FillStyle.value == 'GRADIENT' for g in [s.FillGradient]]

name: page_transparence_gradient
expr: [(n, s.FillTransparenceGradientName, g.Style.value, g.StartColor, g.EndColor) for n in ('Standard','First Page','P_solid','P_solid_transp','P_gradient','P_gradient_transp','P_gradient_tgrad','P_hatch','P_hatch_nobg','P_bitmap_tile','P_bitmap_stretch','P_bitmap_once','P_none','P_shared','P_shared2') for s in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('PageStyles').getByName(n)] if s.FillTransparenceGradientName for g in [s.FillTransparenceGradient]]

name: page_hatch
expr: [(n, h.Style.value, h.Color, h.Distance, h.Angle, s.FillBackground) for n in ('Standard','First Page','P_solid','P_solid_transp','P_gradient','P_gradient_transp','P_gradient_tgrad','P_hatch','P_hatch_nobg','P_bitmap_tile','P_bitmap_stretch','P_bitmap_once','P_none','P_shared','P_shared2') for s in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('PageStyles').getByName(n)] if s.FillStyle.value == 'HATCH' for h in [s.FillHatch]]

name: page_bitmap
expr: [(n, s.FillBitmapMode.value, 'GraphicObject:' in s.FillBitmapURL and 'GraphicObject:0000000' not in s.FillBitmapURL, s.FillBitmapRectanglePoint.value, s.FillBitmapPositionOffsetX, s.FillBitmapPositionOffsetY, s.FillBitmapOffsetX, s.FillBitmapOffsetY, s.FillBitmapLogicalSize, s.FillBitmapSizeX, s.FillBitmapSizeY) for n in ('Standard','First Page','P_solid','P_solid_transp','P_gradient','P_gradient_transp','P_gradient_tgrad','P_hatch','P_hatch_nobg','P_bitmap_tile','P_bitmap_stretch','P_bitmap_once','P_none','P_shared','P_shared2') for s in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('PageStyles').getByName(n)] if s.FillStyle.value == 'BITMAP']

name: header_fill
expr: [(s.HeaderIsOn, s.HeaderFillStyle.value, s.HeaderFillColor, s.HeaderFillHatch.Color, s.HeaderFillBackground) for s in [doc.StyleFamilies.getByName('PageStyles').getByName('P_gradient')]]

name: page_usage
expr: [e.nextElement().PageDescName for e in [doc.Text.createEnumeration()] for i in range(14)]
